rules.topic: Mystical Agradditions adds crop tier 6 (insanium) above supremium, with its own insanium farmland (ModBlocks.java line 32); tier-6 crops include the nether star crop (ModCrops.java line 18) - the resource ceiling of the Mystical family in this pack

Tier-6 progression is boss-gated: the ender dragon drops 8 dragon scales by default (used toward tier-6 seed crafting), and the wither drops a withering soul with 35 percent chance (witheringSoulChance, line 26), the nether star crop's key input
Tier-6 crops cannot be sped up with mystical fertilizer by default config - insanium-tier farming scales by planting area and growth accelerators, not by fertilizer spam
